text: Pertamina Enduro, the VR46 Racing Team's title-sponsor brand, is a product of PT Pertamina Lubricants, which is 99.96% owned by PT Pertamina Patra Niaga, the Pertamina group's downstream subholding.
short: Pertamina Enduro is PT Pertamina Lubricants' brand; the company is 99.96% held by PT Pertamina Patra Niaga.

source.name: PT Pertamina Lubricants: Tentang Kami (About us - company profile and shareholding)
source.note: PT Pertamina Lubricants' own About page (Indonesian): 'PT Pertamina Lubricants is part of the Subholding Downstream PT Pertamina Patra Niaga' and its ownership table lists PT Pertamina Patra Niaga 99.96%, PT Pertamina Pedeve Indonesia 0.04%.

additionalSources.name: VR46 Racing Team: Sponsors (team site)
additionalSources.note: The team's Sponsors page shows Pertamina alone under the heading 'TITLE SPONSOR', with this website link (pertaminalubricants.com is PT Pertamina Lubricants' site).
